## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D2. This is audit backlog UX-31 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: /schedule, Day · receptionist, doctor · 1440, 1024 and 375.
Findings and reviewers: F-35 · reviewer B-14.
Rationale: In the afternoon every visible row is Passed. At 1024 by 768 only 38 % of the screen shows appointments: a helper card sits above the grid for ever, the toolbar wraps and the legend has eight items.
Proposed UX behaviour: Today's day view opens scrolled to the current time. Slots that have passed collapse into one row (Earlier today, with the count of appointments) that opens on demand. Below 1280 px the Select an empty slot helper card is gone and empty slots say Tap to book themselves; Print and Leave move into an overflow menu; the legend sits behind a Key button. With one doctor selected, the column leaves room for the booking panel. Other days open at the first working hour.
Prototype and blueprint reference: No concept screen. docs/product-ux-audit/reviews/reviewer-b-visual-interaction.md, Schedule and B-14.
Components and tokens affected: PageHeader; the existing day grid. No new component.
Front end and back end split: Front end only.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the codemod (same files carry height patches).
Clinical sign-off: Not clinical. The receptionist confirms at the validation session.
Effort and regression risk: S · Low. Booking, reschedule and the slot hold are untouched.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Week and agenda views. (2) Any change to booking rules or the slot hold.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given today's day view at 15:00 clinic time, when it opens, then the first visible slot is within one hour of now
- [ ] **AC2.** Given passed slots with appointments, when the day opens, then they are one collapsed row with a count, and opening it shows each appointment
- [ ] **AC3.** Given 1024 by 768, when the day view loads, then the first slot starts at or above 240 px
- [ ] **AC4.** Given an empty future slot, when it is chosen, then the booking panel opens for that time as today
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the collapsed row, when it is focused, then Enter opens it and it states collapsed or expanded to assistive technology
- [ ] **AC6.** Given English and Arabic, when axe runs, then there is no violation
